comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon projected into world space by road.project(). trigger_radius is in compressed-world metres. needs_owner_review flags entries where map data may differ from lived knowledge — owner's word is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow spit of land between the harbour and the open sea — iconic beachside drive

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout community at the end of the Palisadoes — gateway to Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial and residential community on Windward Road, named for the 17th-century fort

communities.name: Rae Town
communities.note: Historic Kingston waterfront community

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Kingston East community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Kingston's busy crossroads junction — the original uptown/downtown divide

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston — named for the cotton tree that once stood here

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business district — hotels, offices, Emancipation Park

communities.name: Havendale
communities.note: Residential community on Hagley Park Road

communities.name: Three Miles
communities.note: Named for its distance from the Kingston waterfront along Spanish Town Road

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Community on Spanish Town Road — gateway to the west

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former capital — the route passes on the bypass but the city is unmissable

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: Rural community on the approach to Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small village just before the descent into Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community at the heart of the Bog Walk gorge — Rio Cobre and lush cliffs surround you

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Town famous in the folk song — 'Linstead Market, not a quattie wut' sell'

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Rural junction town before the climb to Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Quiet town in the hills — start of the cool-air interior before the descent to Ochi

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Don't drive past hungry.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre canyon of giant tree ferns — one of Jamaica's most dramatic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist capital of the north coast — Dunn's River Falls awaits
